reviews.text:
Can you fix the explanation on the question, “The car "B" is in the intersection, turning right on the red light. However, car "A" comes with green light. Which of the cars should yield?”

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: Absolutely did not include the things that would be on the test. I spend hours studying with this app and went to take the test, just to see that 19/20 of the questions were not at all on the app. Complete waste of time and would not recommend!

reviews.title: Multiple questions are false
reviews.text: Good app its just the fact that some questions are just wrong and illegal. Theres a question talking about a Car A and a Car B that arrive at an intersection and Car B is turning right on red and however Car A has the green and the right answer is that Car B should have yielded to Car A but the right one on the app is that Car A has to yield to Car B but thats just wrong and is just illegal and my question is that why is an app thats supposed to get you ready for your learners permit giving you false information?
